references.text: God says that Abraham shall command his children and his household after him to keep the way of the Lord, which directly relates to the requirement to uphold the covenant through generations.
The promise that Abraham's descendants will become numerous and blessed, as a reward for Abraham's obedience.
God renews the promise to Abraham through Isaac, emphasizing the importance of keeping the covenant and following God's commands.
The psalm reminds us of God's eternal covenant with Abraham and his descendants through generations.
Paul refers to Abraham's offspring and the promise tied to the covenant, linking the old covenant promise to its fulfillment in Christ.
Hebrews discusses God's promise to Abraham and how it was confirmed by an oath, as a precursor to the new covenant.
Hebrews highlights Abraham's faith and obedience as examples for believers, in light of God's promises.
Direct quote of the covenant promising blessing for all nations, showing continuity from Abraham to the first Christians.
